About Mesh

At Mesh, our mission is to enable consumers to pay and be paid with any asset. Today, trillions of dollars in tokenized assets exist but remain largely unusable for everyday commerce. Mesh is bridging this gap by making crypto payments reliable, useful, and ubiquitous. We combine a powerful orchestration engine with a seamless consumer app to unlock liquidity for the world. Backed by leading investors like SBI, Money Forward, Paradigm, Dragonfly, Galaxy, and PayPal Ventures, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of the global economy. Join us!

Overview

Mesh moves money across hundreds of exchanges, wallets and chains. The data that flow generates is now a product in its own right: clients want to see their conversion, volume and settlement data, Finance needs reporting they can sign, and our own teams answer most questions by asking an AI agent instead of filing a ticket. You'll own how we define, instrument, validate and ship that data, working hands-on in SQL and Python and building the guardrails that let AI agents query our data safely.

What You'll Do

  • Own product and client analytics. Define core metrics (conversion rates, transaction success rates) and maintain the central Amplitude data with reusable, templated charts. Build internal and external dashboards for clients.
  • Run experiment readouts. Baseline and read out A/B tests on the flow (UI variants, algorithms) and turn results into product decisions.
  • Prove migrations with data. Build apples-to-apples comparisons between platforms so decisions move on evidence, not gut feel.
  • Guard data integrity. Run and automate daily reconciliation triage and the verification engine.
  • Shape instrumentation. Define backend event schemas and the tracking plan, and normalize fields so the data is clean enough for analytics.
  • Build finance-grade reporting. Deliver settlement and billing reporting on Microsoft Fabric / Power BI with parity validation, alerting and self-serve access for Finance.
  • Make data AI-native. Build skills and tools for our internal data agent, log and audit agent-generated SQL, and keep the self-serve data channels accurate.
  • Turn data into client products. Help shape self-serve reporting, reconciliation and billing exports that clients pay for.

Who You Are

  • Expert in SQL (T-SQL / SQL Server and Spark SQL a plus) and solid in Python
  • Hands-on with product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar), including event design and funnel/CVR modeling
  • Comfortable with experiment design and statistics for A/B readouts
  • Experienced building data quality checks, reconciliations or backfills on production data
  • In the habit of validating numbers against source systems before anyone else sees them
  • A clear writer who can explain a data issue to an engineer, a CRO and a client in the same day
  • A daily user of AI coding and analysis tools
  • ~3+ years in analytics or data engineering
  • ~5+ years with end-to-end ownership of a data domain.

$180,000—$200,000 USD

Why You’ll Love It Here

At Mesh, you're not stepping into a typical role—you're joining a rocket ship in mid-liftoff. You'll tackle complex, meaningful problems that actually move an industry forward, working alongside a sharp, motivated team that moves quickly, collaborates deeply, and expects everyone to operate with ownership. This is the kind of place where you'll see your work ship fast, make real impact, and be able to point to something and say, "I built that." You'll grow fast, level up your skills, and get a front-row seat to how a high-growth company scales from the inside, with competitive comp, solid benefits, and room to stretch your craft all coming standard. If you're energized by building, learning, and shaping something big—this is where you'll want to be.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our San Francisco, New York, and Bangalore hubs are expected to work from the office at least 40% of the time (approximately two days per week). This expectation may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional in-office requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process. Our hybrid approach is designed to balance meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making with the flexibility to work remotely. We believe this structure supports strong execution while preserving autonomy and focus time.

How We Care For Our Team

We believe great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That starts with competitive salary and equity that grows as you and the company grow, plus comprehensive health coverage for you and your family. We offer unlimited PTO—and we mean it. Take the time you need to recharge and show up at your best.

We're invested in your growth with a dedicated budget for courses, conferences, and certifications. Work from wherever you're most productive with our remote-friendly approach, and count on having the top-tier tools and equipment you need to do exceptional work.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Acquiring team owns the acquiring side of card payments for Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. When someone pays with a card at a Square seller, through Afterpay, or uses a card to move money in or out of Cash App, our systems make sure that payment happens correctly, every time.

We take in and tokenize card data from chip, tap, digital wallets, and online checkout, route each payment, and get it authorized over our direct network connections and acquiring partners. Then we capture, clear, and settle it, in the US and internationally. Across Square and Cash App, Block processed nearly $260 billion in payment volume in 2025, and we run our own direct connections to card networks in several countries alongside our acquiring partners. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems route the authorization and bring back the issuer's answer in under a second, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Acquiring team, you will bring deep card payments experience to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. That work includes expanding our direct network and acquirer connections, delivering network mandates, and making it cheaper and more reliable to accept cards. You will lead one or two of these projects at a time. If you have worked deep in the card payment stack, at a payments company, a card network, or a large merchant, and want to own hard problems at Block's scale, this role is built for you.

This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your payments expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. Much of the team built its payments depth here at Block. You will bring a view of how other companies solve the same problems, and learn our systems from a team that knows them deeply.

In your first year, you will ship at least one of those projects to production, leave behind standards and tooling that make the next one easier, and share what you learned elsewhere so the whole team goes deeper. You will report to the engineering manager for Acquiring.

This role works US West Coast hours, from our Bay Area or Seattle offices or remotely within the Pacific time zone. The team is mostly in US Eastern and Australian time zones, and Pacific hours overlap with US Eastern in the morning and with Melbourne in the late afternoon.

You Will

  • Bring deep card acceptance expertise to the team, reading network specifications, ISO 8583 messages, mandates, and interchange rules, and turning them into sound engineering decisions.
  • Own the technical direction of your projects from design through production rollout, and lead the engineers working on them.
  • Partner with our technical leads, product and finance operations partners, and stakeholders across Square, Cash App, and Afterpay to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's acquiring platform.
  • Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build testing and certification tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level.
  • Make and defend the technical calls on routing, retries, and processing cost, backed by data on authorization rates and fees.
  • Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make payments expertise durable so the team makes good payments decisions without routing every question through you.
  • Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment. Help grow the next staff engineers on the team.
  • Build with AI agents across the engineering lifecycle, and help set the patterns for using them safely on systems that move money.
  • Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness

You Have

  • Deep card payments experience at the message level: you have built or run the integrations that talk to networks, acquirers, or processors (ISO 8583 or an acquirer's host format), not only called a payment provider's API. Acquiring or merchant-side experience is ideal, and a direct network connection is a strong plus. ISO 20022 is a plus.
  • Experience with the hard cases in real card transactions, such as partial and incremental authorizations, reversals, tips, currency conversion, and interchange qualification.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating highly reliable financial or payments systems at scale, with solid habits in design review, automated testing, and safe, observable rollouts.
  • A track record of leading technically complex projects from design through delivery and setting technical direction for the engineers working on them.
  • Experience creating durable technical leverage — frameworks, standards, tooling, architecture, or practices that other engineers and teams adopt.
  • Broad understanding of how a card payment moves end to end, with depth in areas such as card data security and tokenization, routing, authorization, capture, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, interchange and processing costs, or chargebacks.
  • Solid understanding of card network rules (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and US debit networks), and of how acquirers, processors, payment facilitators, and sponsor banks fit between sellers and the networks.
  • Daily experience building with AI coding agents, and good judgment about when their output is right.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for critical financial systems.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.


If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Vision & Strategy

Uphold is a financial technology company that believes on-chain services are the future of finance. We provide modern infrastructure for on-chain payments, banking and investments. Uphold strips away the complexity to open up Web3 finance for everyone.

To learn more about Uphold, please visit https://uphold.com.

Job Summary

Uphold is looking for Marketing Technology Manager, CRM Platform a  to take full ownership of Customer.io, the platform we use to communicate with millions of customers across email, push, in-app and SMS.

This is a technical role, not a campaign execution role. You will own the data model, the integrations, the workflow architecture and the operating standards that make customer communication possible at scale. You will sit between Engineering, Data, Marketing and Commercial, and you will be the person who decides how the platform is built and how it is used.

The scope is wide. Uphold runs multiple products and regions on shared infrastructure, in a highly regulated industry, with a large volume of personal data. Getting this right means designing for reuse, for auditability and for safety, not just for the next campaign.

What you’ll be doing primarily

Own the CRM data foundation

  • Own the data layer inside Customer.io: Define and maintain the objects, attributes, events and identifiers that power the platform. Segmentation quality is a direct function of data quality, so this is the core of the role.
  • Work hand in hand with Engineering and Data: Design and maintain the pipelines that feed Customer.io. Agree on schemas, event contracts and data freshness requirements, and hold the line when they drift.
  • Guarantee freshness and correctness: Put monitoring and alerting in place so that stale, missing or malformed data is caught before it reaches a customer, not after.

Architect workflows that last

  • Apply systems thinking to campaign design: Build journeys, triggers and segments that are modular, reusable and understandable by someone who did not build them.
  • Prevent workflow sprawl: Establish naming conventions, versioning, documentation and deprecation routines. Retire what is no longer used. Treat the CRM workspace as a codebase, not a folder of one off campaigns.
  • Design for scale: Anticipate volume, message throughput, rate limits and platform constraints before they become production issues.

Operate with a multi product and multi brand mindset

  • Serve several products and brands from one platform: Design workspace structure, data models and templates so that Wallet, Topper, Enterprise and future brands share what should be shared and separate what must be separated.
  • Balance consistency with autonomy: Give each product team room to move without letting the overall architecture fragment.
  • Manage cross brand message pressure: Own global frequency capping, priority rules and suppression logic so customers receive a coherent experience across products.

Translate business objectives into CRM capability

  • Partner with Marketing and Commercial: Understand what the business is trying to achieve, then decide what the platform needs to look like to support it. Push back when a request is better solved a different way.
  • Turn requirements into architecture: Convert commercial goals into concrete data, segmentation and workflow design, with clear trade offs and sequencing.
  • Own the roadmap for the platform: Maintain a prioritised view of platform work and communicate it to stakeholders.

Enable marketing autonomy

  • Build for self sufficiency: Create templates, reusable components, documented segments and clear guardrails so marketing teams can launch routine work without engineering support.
  • Train and document: Run enablement sessions and maintain practical documentation. Success is measured by how much the teams can do without you, not by how much depends on you.
  • Set the guardrails: Define what marketers can change freely, what needs review, and what is locked. Make the safe path the easy path.

Drive automation and AI adoption

  • Identify automation opportunities: Look for manual, repetitive or error prone steps across the CRM operation and remove them.
  • Apply AI where it earns its place: Evaluate and implement AI for content generation, send time and channel optimisation, segmentation, anomaly detection and QA. Be pragmatic about where it adds value and where it does not.
  • Keep improving the operation: Measure the cycle time from business request to live campaign, and work it down.

Security and data protection first

  • Treat personal data with care: This is a PII heavy environment. Apply data minimisation, least privilege access, retention rules and clear handling standards by default.
  • Own consent and preferences: Maintain the consent, opt out and preference model, and make sure it is respected consistently across every channel and every brand.
  • Support compliance and audit: Work with Security, Privacy, Compliance and Legal on GDPR, access reviews, vendor risk and audit evidence. Be able to explain who received what, when, and on what basis.
  • Respect jurisdictional rules: Uphold operates under multiple regulatory regimes. Build the targeting and suppression logic that keeps communications compliant by market, including mandatory risk warnings and geographic restrictions on financial promotions.

Protect quality at the customer touchpoint

  • Be detail and quality obsessed: Every message is a direct customer touchpoint and a reflection of the brand. Own the QA process, including test sends, seed lists, rendering checks, link validation and pre send review.
  • Own deliverability: Manage domain and IP reputation, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warm up, list hygiene, bounce and complaint rates. Deliverability is an engineering problem, and it belongs to this role.
  • Run change management: Define approval gates, no send windows, rollback procedures and incident response for communication failures.
  • Measure and improve: Own experimentation design, holdout groups and performance reporting, in partnership with the Data team.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • BS or advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in the field, with meaningful time spent owning a marketing automation, CRM or customer engagement platform in a technical capacity.
  • Hands-on experience with Customer.io, or a comparable platform such as Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, at an architecture and administration level rather than campaign execution only.
  • Strong SQL and comfort working with data warehouses and modern data pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, event driven data models and identity resolution.
  • Working knowledge of templating languages such as Liquid, plus HTML, CSS and JavaScript for email and in-app content.
  • Demonstrated systems thinking: the ability to design maintainable, scalable structures rather than solve each request in isolation.
  • Experience working with personal data under a security and privacy first approach, including consent management and GDPR.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non technical audiences.
  • Comfortable working across functions with Marketing, Commercial, Product, Data and Engineering.
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail.
  • Fluent written and oral English.


Salary: $150K + Bonus, Benefits 

Bonus if you have

  • Experience in fintech, financial services or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with cryptocurrencies or other digital assets, as they are core to our business.
  • Experience running CRM across multiple products or brands from a single platform.
  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms and reverse ETL tooling.
  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt or similar modern data stack tooling.
  • Practical experience applying AI tooling to marketing or CRM operations.
  • Deep email deliverability experience, including reputation management and remediation.
  • Experience integrating mobile SDKs for push and in-app messaging.
  • Community talks, certifications, and/or blog posts on your interests and research.
  • Open source project contributions of any kind.

Importantly, if you are looking for a senior role with us, you will have achieved many of the things above while also providing mentorship to others, and have engaged in public speaking opportunities.
